title: Where the eufy HomeBase HomeKit code is
description: eufy prints the HomeKit setup code on the bottom of HomeBase 2. A system already in the eufy app can enable HomeKit from HomeBase Settings without the printed code.
lede: Look under the HomeBase. eufy prints the setup code on its bottom, and if the system is already in the eufy app you may not need the sticker at all.

rows.text: eufy: scan the Setup Code on the bottom of HomeBase. The eufy page for this flow covers eufyCam 2, 2C, 2 Pro and 2C Pro, with up to 4 cameras per HomeBase 2 exposed; eufy's current HomeKit list names more models.
A QR code with the Home logo goes straight into Apple Home. One without the house mark belongs to the eufy app: add the system there first and enable HomeKit from HomeBase Settings, HomeKit Setup.
No printed code is needed: go to HomeBase Settings, HomeKit Setup.
A pin in the reset button on the back of the HomeBase resets it and erases all settings and videos.

sources.label: eufy: set up HomeKit for eufyCam 2, 2C, 2 Pro, 2C Pro
